findings.summary: AI-generated PR, closed on sight under the org policy
Removes the second context push, so teardown runs after the view returns and again on every chunk, breaking the documented streaming contract
Regression test asserts only that teardown ran on the worker thread, which passes with or without the fix
Stale comments in tests/test_testing.py left behind
Body claim about stale worker context is unsupported by the test; cross-thread side effects unmentioned
No CHANGES.rst entry or versionchanged notes, no issue discussion

why: Finding 1 cites the AI policy and finding 2 spells out the repeated push, teardown and pop on every chunk, both of which the maintainer gave as reasons to close. A maintainer reading finding 1 alone would close it.
